address: Thurn-und-Taxis-Platz 2, Frankfurt on the Main, 60313, Germany
bio: Above the upscale bar on the ground floor of the JW Marriott Hotel Frankfurt in the city centre, you come to this stylish and elegantly designed restaurant on the first floor. The charming team serves up a slice of Latin America, from tacos and ceviche GRETA OTO (take your pick from salmon, sea bass or king prawns) to mushroom karaage, aji verde sauce and cashews. Pick your dishes à la carte – they are designed for sharing....
